name: SummerSong
street_address: Goodspeed's Terris Theatre, 33 North Main Street
description_short: A youth musical theater camp run by Goodspeed Musicals at its Terris Theatre in Chester, for ages 7 to 18 in separate age groups. Goodspeed staff teach singing, dancing and acting each day and show how a musical is made, and each session ends with a showcase for family and friends.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Page says SummerSong is returning for summer 2027 and lists session dates by age group without a year; June 28 to July 2 and the other ranges fall Monday to Friday in 2027. Email is for the Education and Engagement Manager. No price is posted.

changes: Name is the camp's own name, SummerSong (the discovery pass called it Goodspeed SummerSong).
for_andrew: The page heads the dates 'Returning for Summer 2027' but prints them without a year and says 2027 details are coming soon. I recorded them as 2027 because every range runs Monday to Friday in 2027 (not in 2026). OK to publish them as 2027 dates?
The camp is held at the Terris Theatre in Chester, so the city is Chester, not East Haddam where Goodspeed is based.
